    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[index])
        c = int(input[index + 1])
        q = int(input[index + 2])
        index += 3
        p = list(map(int, input[index:index + n]))
        index += n
        queries = []
        for _ in range(q):
            i = int(input[index])
            j = int(input[index + 1])
            queries.append((i, j))
            index += 2
        possible_permutations = set()
        for l in range(n):
            for r in range(l, min(l + c + 1, n)):
                new_p = p[:]
                new_p[l:r+1] = reversed(new_p[l:r+1])
                possible_permutations.add(tuple(new_p))
        possible_permutations = sorted(possible_permutations)
        for i, j in queries:
            if j - 1 < len(possible_permutations):
                results.append(str(possible_permutations[j - 1][i - 1]))
            else:
                results.append('-1')
    print('\n'.join(results))
